name: Da Nang
tagline: A beach base for central Vietnam
summary: Use Da Nang for beach mornings, the Marble Mountains and Cham sculpture, then leave whole days for Ba Na Hills or neighbouring Hoi An. The coast and inland attractions are too spread out to combine everything into one efficient day.
seasonNote: Central Vietnam can have heavy rain and storms later in the year. Hills are cooler and may be clouded in even when the coast is sunny.
arrival: Da Nang International Airport is close to the city; the railway station connects north and south.
gettingAround: Use walking for a local beach or riverfront cluster and booked cars for separated sights. Plan return transport for hill excursions.
cashTip: Carry small dong notes for local food and markets; use reputable cash machines and check fees.
foodTip: Try central Vietnamese pancakes, noodle dishes and seafood. Fish sauce, shrimp and pork can be hidden in sauces; use named dietary venues.
buyTip: Han Market has local food gifts and clothing; compare prices and check ingredients and baggage rules.
baseArea: My Khe / An Thuong for beach cafés; Hai Chau for riverfront and central sights.
